title: 第198章 交代第197章 昨夜与清晨
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
典狱长办公室内
随着最后到来的莎娜关上办公室门，鸢尾花监狱的所有管理人员也都聚齐在了这里
典狱长：狄曼列·该隐赫斯特
副典狱长：赫尔莎：卡罗尔
第一监区长：莎娜·卡塞
第二监区长：柯蕾·阿迪休
第四、五监区长：维罗娜·斯菲亚
狱医兼代理典狱长：露诺·卡娅
.......
狄曼列看着各自找到自己座位的几人，无视了怀里萝莉般娇小的莎娜，平静的开口：“有件事，我应该会离开监狱一段时间，我要回一趟异端审判局”
闻言，赫尔莎与露诺她们全部愣了一下，只有维罗娜表情如常的坐在椅子上
露诺皱了皱眉：“又出什么事了？”
“不算出事，正常工作”，狄曼列摇了摇头：“维罗娜会和我一起去”
话音落下，几人忍不住全部看向了维罗娜
而维罗娜感受到目光，下意识的有些紧张，身体也稍微坐直了一些
露诺转头看向狄曼列，盯了几秒后才开口：“你，不会是要把她切片做实验了吧？”
狄曼列无语了一会儿：“你把我想成什么人了？”
“毫无道德的疯狂魔法师”，露诺白了狄曼列一眼，看向维罗娜：“维罗娜，你同意了吗？”
“嗯，同意了”，维罗娜点了点头：“典狱长大人说有一些关于元素精灵龙的起源，需要我去验证一下”
柯蕾有些惊讶的把玩着火元素晶石：“你昨天和典狱长居然不止进行了身体交流吗？”

瞬间，维罗娜又脸红的低下头，害羞的不知说什么
露诺继续看着狄曼列：“会有危险吗？这个问题是对你和维罗娜两个人”
狄曼列摇了摇头：“不会，只是记录一下维罗娜的魔力样本，主要是带她看一下审判局里的一些设备，只有理论的话会限制她的发展”
狄曼列没有告诉露诺实际情况，一方面是露诺她们会担心，另一方面是许多信息太危险依旧无法让露诺她们知道
再者，他对自己的伤势能否恢复这件事其实心里也没有底
露诺没有继续多问，只是点了点头：“知道了，你们会离开多久？”
“可能几天就回来，最多十天”，狄曼列揉了揉莎娜的脸：
“在这期间，赫尔莎你代理典狱长的职位，有急事就用电话打我的魔导终端，方法你知道的”
赫尔莎优雅的点了点头：“好的，典狱长”
“你啊”，露诺无奈的揉了揉眉心，看向赫尔莎：“忙不过来的话找我，草药协会那边最近没工作”
“好的，谢谢啦”，赫尔莎微笑道
狄曼列微微笑了笑，继续开口：“审判局和莫森帝国皇室交涉过了，在我离开期间不会有人来拜访。如果有任何不对劲的外来人员想要进入监狱，让他们立刻离开。要是停留超过一个标准，允许视作敌人击杀”
话音落下，赫尔莎她们都忍不住打了个寒颤，清晰的感受到那份声音中的冰冷
狄曼列活动了一下手指：“上次幻神教会是为了清洗一下不安分的家伙。这次再有什么你们应对不了的情况，【座天使】会直接出手，不用对祂有戒备”
“那个眼球很多的大小姐？”，露诺疑惑的开口：“可以信任？”
“嗯，可以信任”，狄曼列点了点头
“好”
狄曼列捋着莎娜的侧马尾：“第五监区暂时不用巡查了，至于第四监区。赫尔莎，暂时交给你”
“是”，赫尔莎点了点头
狄曼列继续开口：“到时候会有一个东西来帮你的，不用担心有危险”

“明白”
狄曼列看向将花盆当作哑铃锻炼肌肉的柯蕾：“柯蕾，我离开这段时间，所有对圣骑士、司法部、领主的举报信辛苦你接收一下，然后去找一下莱斯和卡鲁还有休摩西子爵。如果他们一天内没解决或者没给解决方案，告诉他们，我亲自去找他们”
content_en:
Inside the warden's office
As Shana finally arrived and closed the office door, all the managers of Iris Prison gathered here.
Warden: Diamaniel Cainhurst
Deputy Warden: Helsa: Carol
Superintendent of the First Ward: Shanna Kase
Superintendent of the Second District: Ke Lei Addihu
Director of the Fourth and Fifth Wards: Verona Sphia
Prison doctor and acting warden: Runo Kaya
.......
Diamanlie looked at the few people who had found their own seats. He ignored Shana, who was as petite as a lolita in his arms, and said calmly: "There is something. I should leave the prison for a while. I want to go back to the Heretic Bureau."
Hearing this, Helsa and Luna were all stunned for a moment. Only Verona sat on the chair with a normal expression.
Lunuo frowned: "What happened again?"
"Nothing is wrong, just work normally." Diamanlie shook his head: "Verona will go with me."
After the words fell, several people couldn't help but look at Verona.
When Verona felt the gaze, she subconsciously became nervous and sat up a little straighter.
Lunuo turned to look at Diamanlie and stared for a few seconds before speaking: "Are you going to cut her into slices for experiments?"
Dimanlie was speechless for a while: "Who do you think I am?"
"A crazy magician with no morals." Luno rolled her eyes at Dimanlie and looked at Verona: "Verona, do you agree?"
"Yes, agreed." Verona nodded: "The warden said there is something about the origin of the elemental elf dragon, and I need to verify it."
Ke Lei played with the fire element crystal in surprise: "Did you and the warden have more than just physical communication yesterday?"
In an instant, Verona blushed and lowered her head, too shy not to know what to say.
Luno continued to look at Diamanlie: "Is there any danger? This question is for you and Verona."
Diamanlie shook his head: "No, I'm just recording a sample of Verona's magic power. I mainly want to show her some of the equipment in the Trial Bureau. Only theories will limit her development."
Dimanlie did not tell Lunuo the actual situation. On the one hand, Lunuo and the others would be worried. On the other hand, a lot of information was too dangerous and still could not be known to Lunuo and the others.
Furthermore, he actually had no idea whether his injuries could be recovered.
Lunuo didn't ask any more questions, just nodded: "I understand, how long will you leave?"
"Maybe I'll be back in a few days, ten days at most." Diamanlie rubbed Shana's face:
"During this period, Helsa, you are acting as the warden. If you have any emergency, just call my magic terminal on the phone. You know the method."
Helsa nodded gracefully: "Okay, Warden"
"You", Lunuo rubbed her brows helplessly and looked at Helsa: "If you are too busy, come to me. There is no work at the Herbal Medicine Association recently."
"Okay, thank you," Helsa smiled.
Diamanlie smiled slightly and continued: "The Inquisition Bureau has negotiated with the royal family of the Mohsen Empire. No one will come to visit me while I am away. If there are any inappropriate outsiders who want to enter the prison, let them leave immediately. If they stay beyond a certain standard, they are allowed to be treated as enemies and killed."
After the words fell, Helsa and the others couldn't help but shudder, clearly feeling the coldness in the voice.
Diamanlie moved his fingers: "Last time, the Illusory God Church was to cleanse the restless ones. If there is any situation that you can't handle this time, [Angel] will take action directly, so there is no need to be wary of him."
"That young lady with a lot of eyeballs?" Luno asked doubtfully: "Can you trust me?"
"Yes, you can trust me." Diamanlie nodded.
"good"
Diamanlie stroked Shana's side ponytail: "There is no need to patrol the fifth prison district for the time being. As for the fourth prison district, Helsa, I will leave it to you for the time being."
"Yes", Helsa nodded.
DiManlie continued: "Someone will come to help you when the time comes, so don't worry about being in danger."
"Understand"
Diamanlie looked at Ke Lei, who was using the flower pot as a dumbbell to exercise his muscles: "Ke Lei, while I am away, please accept all the reports against the Paladins, the Ministry of Justice, and the lords, and then go find Rice, Carew, and Viscount Hu Moses. If they don't solve it within one day or don't give a solution, tell them, and I will go find them myself."
